newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Estates eyes two new projects.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Estates eyes two new projects.

text.p: Philippine Estate Corp said on Monday it had signed two separate agreements to develop an upscale leisure estate and build a high-rise condominium building.

In a disclosure to the Philippine Stock Exchange, the company said it had signed a memorandum of agreement with unlisted Urban Property Holdings to develop a 54.4 hectare lot in the hillside resort of Tagaytay city into a leisure estate.
A joint venture agreement was also signed with Filipinas (Prefab Building) Systems Inc to build a 52-storey mixed-use condominium building in downtown Manila, the company said.
